title: README run command `go run main.go` fails to compile multi-file package
evidence: README.md:26 says `go run main.go`, but handlers/models/db live in db.go, handlers.go, models.go; building only main.go errors with undefined healthHandler/listBooksHandler/etc.
suggestion: Change the run instruction to `go run .` so the whole package compiles.

title: created_at/updated_at scanned into locals then discarded
evidence: db.go:63 and db.go:79 scan the created_at/updated_at columns into local `createdAt, updatedAt string` vars that are never assigned to the Book struct, so JSON responses always return zero-value timestamps.
suggestion: Parse the scanned strings into b.CreatedAt/b.UpdatedAt, or drop the unused columns from the SELECT and struct.
